Name: CMYK
Desc: The "printer's model:" the quantity of each secondary colour (cyan, magenta, yellow), along with the key (black).
CMYKCTrack: Drag SELECT to change the cyan component.
CMYKCKnob: Drag SELECT to change the cyan component.
CMYKMTrack: Drag SELECT to change the magenta component.
CMYKMKnob: Drag SELECT to change the magenta component.
CMYKYTrack: Drag SELECT to change the yellow component.
CMYKYKnob: Drag SELECT to change the yellow component.
CMYKKTrack: Drag SELECT to change the black component.
CMYKKKnob: Drag SELECT to change the black component.
CMYKCPercent: Type a new value for the percentage of cyan.
CMYKMPercent: Type a new value for the percentage of magenta.
CMYKYPercent: Type a new value for the percentage of yellow.
CMYKKPercent: Type a new value for the percentage of black.
CMYKCUp: Press SELECT, ADJUST, |!|KSELECT or |!|KADJUST to alter the cyan component.
CMYKCDown: Press SELECT, ADJUST, |!|KSELECT or |!|KADJUST to alter the cyan component.
CMYKMUp: Press SELECT, ADJUST, |!|KSELECT or |!|KADJUST to alter the magenta component.
CMYKMDown: Press SELECT, ADJUST, |!|KSELECT or |!|KADJUST to alter the magenta component.
CMYKYUp: Press SELECT, ADJUST, |!|KSELECT or |!|KADJUST to alter the yellow component.
CMYKYDown: Press SELECT, ADJUST, |!|KSELECT or |!|KADJUST to alter the yellow component.
CMYKKUp: Press SELECT, ADJUST, |!|KSELECT or |!|KADJUST to alter the black component.
CMYKKDown: Press SELECT, ADJUST, |!|KSELECT or |!|KADJUST to alter the black component.
